title: Cubic-rate irrationality for reciprocal sums
summary: Every positive strictly increasing zero-indexed integer sequence a with n^3(a_n^2/a_(n+1) - 1 - 3/n) tending to zero has an irrational reciprocal sum. The entry also states the exact integer-tail and number-field steps used to exclude the resulting cubic profile: positive-density exceptions, primitive gcd reduction, square specialisation, scale twelve, forbidden words modulo seven, and regular-rate extraction.
